text:
Alex M.: Quick heads-up — prepping v2.7.0 version bump and changelog push. Can we run a short preflight CI smoke pass before the cutoff?
Priya Singh: What time is cutoff today?
Alex M.: 17:00 PT. Ideally want a green sweep by 15:30 to give room for fixes.
Emily R.: Noted. FYI mac-arm job is flaky on main-ci: https://ci.redwood/boards/3421 (failing with timeouts on `tests/integration/test_streaming.py`)
Jon K.: Is that the same timeout we saw last week? test_streaming tends to hit the 2m socket read occasionally.
Emily R.: Looks similar but stacktrace shows `grpc._channel._Rendezvous` and then a long wait. Repro locally on my M1 with `pytest tests/integration/test_streaming.py -q` (intermittent).
Rob T.: Quick idea — can we bump that test's timeout in CI to 120s for the smoke sweep? If it passes elsewhere we can revert.
Priya Singh: I'd rather avoid changing tests right before cutoff. Can we isolate by running only critical suites: unit, smoke, perf?
Alex M.: Good call. Let's run a targeted sweep: `ci run suite=smoke,unit --parallel=6` and skip known flaky integration ones.
ci-bot: ci job started: smoke+unit sweep (run id: 84621) — https://ci.redwood/runs/84621
Jon K.: I'll kick off a local reproducer on an intel worker to compare. If it's mac-specific we can mark mac-arm as allowed-failure for the sweep.
Emily R.: I can try a rerun with increased verbosity to capture grpc traces: `GRPC_TRACE=all GRPC_VERBOSITY=DEBUG pytest tests/integration/test_streaming.py`
Rob T.: If marking allowed-failure, we should still create a quick ticket linking traces and tag it as release-blocker if it regresses other platforms.
Priya Singh: Assigning myself to triage the mac runs in the sweep. If I hit a blocking failure I'll ping infra-team.
Alex M.: Thanks. Also small changelog nudge: please add a one-liner under "Bug fixes" for the image caching optimization — whoever owns the change, drop it in PR #4287 before 14:00 PT.
Jon K.: I added a draft line to #4287. Will refine after the smoke results.
ci-bot: ci run 84621: unit=green, smoke=partially_failed (3/18 flaky integration, 1 mac-arm timeout) — details: https://ci.redwood/runs/84621/logs
Emily R.: Saw the mac-arm timeout on run 84621. I re-ran only `test_streaming` and it passed on the second attempt. Sounds flaky.
Rob T.: Ok mark mac-arm integration as allowed-failure for the release sweep and open a follow-up ticket: "mac-arm flaky: test_streaming grpc timeout" assigned to infra/qa.
Priya Singh: Created ticket RINF-2032, assigned to infra-team, linked the run logs.
Alex M.: With units and smoke green (modulo allowed mac flake), I think we're good for the bump — Jon, Priya, Rob: can one of you cut the v2.7.0 tag after 15:45 PT?
Jon K.: I can cut it at 15:50 if all looks good.
Priya Singh: I'll monitor CI until the cut and ping if anything new pops. :thumbsup:
Alex M.: Thanks all. One post-release follow-up: plan a short retro next week to dig into flaky mac tests and determine mitigation (emulation infra vs. test tweaks).
